title: Characterization of autologous conditioned serum (ACS) and its extracellular vesicles (EVs) from blood samples of volunteer donors
summary:
The project aims to learn more about blood components by using standard cell culture systems. This should help us to understand biological relationships.
To do so, we are using blood samples from twenty volunteer donors.
conditions: Characterization of autologous conditioned serum (ACS) and its extracellular vesicles (EVs)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Healthy voluntary blood donors.
2. Aged between 18 and 70.
3. Have adequate communication skills.
4. Patients must understand the nature, significance and scope of the research project, and be able to act in accordance with their own free will.
Exclusion criteria:
1. None
